description: This file defines a data class 'ProductFilter' used for filtering products in an online shopping platform. It includes optional filtering parameters such as category and price range, and provides a method to check if any filter is active.

classes.name: ProductFilter
classes.description: A data class representing filter criteria for product listings, including optional category and price range filters, with a method to determine if any filter is active.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Returns true if any filter criteria (category, minPriceCents, maxPriceCents) are set; otherwise, false.
